title: The Last Salt Anew
premise: Marguerite Vasquez, exiled storm-caller and ledger-keeper for the Guild of Impossible Things, discovers the border wards fell on the same night the stars went out because someone inside the guild sold the country's name to a rival power. As winter falls without end, Marguerite must trace the theft through his own ledgers, confronting the truth that he erased his own memory to survive exile. In the end, he chooses to restore what he forgot, unmask the traitor, and open the last door out of a country that exists only in its people's remembering.
about_author: Casper Dravenmoor is the pen name of a former archivist who spent a decade cataloguing confiscated grimoires before turning to fiction. They write from a coastal town where the fog, they insist, keeps their secrets better than any vault.

chapters.title: The Night the Stars Went Out
chapters.summary: Marguerite's POV. During a routine inventory of impossible goods, the stars vanish and the border wards collapse with a sound like breaking glass. The guild seals its doors. Emotional beat: dread beneath practiced calm.

chapters.title: Ledgers of the Impossible
chapters.summary: Marguerite's POV. He audits the guild's books and finds an entry written in his own handwriting that he cannot remember making: a sale of 'one country's true name.' Emotional beat: vertigo of self-doubt.

chapters.title: The Guild of Impossible Things
chapters.summary: Guildmaster Odile's POV. She convenes the guild's inner circle, hiding her suspicion that the leak came from within. Marguerite watches her lie smoothly. Emotional beat: uneasy loyalty.

chapters.title: What the Winter Remembers
chapters.summary: Marguerite's POV. Snow begins falling and does not stop; refugees arrive carrying memories that fade as they cross the threshold. Marguerite realizes memory itself is being harvested. Emotional beat: grief hardening into purpose.

chapters.title: A Door That Was Never Built
chapters.summary: Marguerite's POV. Following a ledger clue, he finds a hidden door in the guild's cellar that opens onto a country he half-remembers. Emotional beat: longing for a past he cannot access.

chapters.title: The Storm I Used to Be
chapters.summary: Flashback chapter, Marguerite's POV. Fragments surface: why he was exiled, the storm he called down on a city, the face of the person he saved or killed. Emotional beat: shame and denial.

chapters.title: Odile's Bargain
chapters.summary: Odile's POV. She meets secretly with an envoy from the rival power, Vhalcrest, trading safe passage for guild neutrality. Marguerite follows her and misreads what he sees. Emotional beat: betrayal mistaken for confirmation.

chapters.title: The Cartographer of Absence
chapters.summary: New character Sefa's POV. A mapmaker who charts places that no longer exist recruits Marguerite, revealing the stolen name is being rewritten onto Vhalcrest maps. Emotional beat: cautious alliance.

chapters.title: Ink That Lies
chapters.summary: Marguerite's POV. He discovers pages torn from his ledgers and forged entries designed to frame him. Someone knows his hand intimately. Emotional beat: paranoia.

chapters.title: The Long Winter Falls
chapters.summary: Sefa's POV. The endless winter kills the outer districts; the guild hoards warmth like currency. Marguerite must choose between safety and action. Emotional beat: moral awakening.

chapters.title: Names Are Debts
chapters.summary: Marguerite's POV. An old debt-collector of names reveals that Marguerite himself once sold something to Vhalcrest—his own memories—as payment for exile. Emotional beat: devastating recognition.

chapters.title: The Traitor's Handwriting
chapters.summary: Odile's POV. Odile confronts her deputy Corvane with evidence, but Corvane turns the guild against her, claiming she conspired with Vhalcrest. Emotional beat: power inverted.

chapters.title: Fugitive in a White Country
chapters.summary: Marguerite's POV. Branded a traitor alongside Odile, he flees into the snowbound city with Sefa, hunted by guild enforcers. Emotional beat: fear sharpened by resolve.

chapters.title: The House of Forgotten Doors
chapters.summary: Sefa's POV. They shelter in Sefa's archive of unmapped places and find the original contract bearing Marguerite's signature—and a second signature beneath it: Corvane's. Emotional beat: hope rekindled.

chapters.title: What Marguerite Forgot
chapters.summary: Marguerite's POV. He learns the storm he called destroyed Vhalcrest's first invasion—the exile was punishment for saving the country once. His erased memory holds the counter-ward. Emotional beat: identity reclaimed.

chapters.title: The Price of Remembering
chapters.summary: Marguerite's POV. Restoring his memories may kill him; the ritual requires a witness who loves him enough to hold his name. Odile volunteers. Emotional beat: terrified trust.

chapters.title: Corvane's Country
chapters.summary: Corvane's POV. Inside Vhalcrest's embassy, Corvane prepares to sign the country away permanently, believing erasure is mercy compared to war. Emotional beat: chilling conviction.

chapters.title: Storm-Called
chapters.summary: Marguerite's POV. The memory ritual succeeds violently: every storm he ever called returns at once, and he walks out of the archive wreathed in lightning. Emotional beat: terrible rebirth.

chapters.title: The Door Out of Nowhere
chapters.summary: Marguerite and Odile's alternating POV. They storm the embassy as the final signing begins; Odile takes a wound meant for Marguerite. Emotional beat: sacrifice and fury.

chapters.title: The Name in the Ledger
chapters.summary: Climax, Marguerite's POV. Facing Corvane amid the collapsing wards, Marguerite writes the country's true name back into existence using his own ledgers as anchor, calling the storm down one last time. Emotional beat: triumph at great cost.

chapters.title: Stars, Returning
chapters.summary: Marguerite's POV. The stars return; the winter breaks. The guild must reckon with what it became, and Odile survives but steps down. Emotional beat: exhausted relief.

chapters.title: Anew
chapters.summary: Epilogue, Marguerite's POV. Offered restoration of rank, Marguerite instead opens the door out of the old country and stays to help write the new one, keeping honest ledgers at last. Emotional beat: quiet belonging.
